messages:
olivia-logistics: AWB 223-7789001 stuck at FRA, manifest NACKs. carrier says partner EDI gateway timed out. need decision: hold for manual broker review or split-air 7 H100s.
vendor-forwarder: Confirmed. Partner EDI had intermittent failures; manifest rejected and broker requested manual review. ETA for manual clear ~20h. We can split and air-move 7 units FRA->LHR next-day for +€70k. Need go-ahead by 16:30 CET to secure slots.
olivia-logistics: Any customs paperwork gaps? last time HS/COO caused delay.
vendor-forwarder: Paperwork complete. Customs flagged a thermal sample inspection on 3 units; depot requests photos + serial reconciliation prior to release.
procurement: If we air-split, can you guarantee a single RMA chain per serial and preserve warranty/insurance flow?
vendor-forwarder: Yes — warranty follows serial numbers. We'll attach the same RMA reference across any split AWBs. Depot photos + signed manifest will initiate the RMA flow.
rma-bot: RMA created: RMA-5580 linked to AWB 223-7789001. Status: awaiting depot photos and signed attestation.
anna-ops: If the EDI outage is on the forwarder/partner side, can we get a surcharge credit for the uplift? escalate please.
vendor-forwarder: Escalated to partner ops. They acknowledged a gateway fault and opened a surcharge dispute. They'll request partial credit for uplift; cannot promise yet. Update expected in ~3h.
sre: Quick impact: those 7 units support two EU-west Dedicated pools. A 24-36h hold increases queue latency ~22% at peak. Canary scaling is prepped to mitigate but won't fully cover customer cutovers.
procurement: I'll provisionally approve the €70k uplift pending partner credit confirmation. Finance to greenlight final spend if credit denied.
olivia-logistics: Holding for credit decision. If waiver denied, execute air-split at 16:30 CET. Vendor: please prioritize depot photos and signed manifest attestation. :thumbsup:
